items.reason: This is the adapalene gel you asked for, a nightly leave-on aimed at the look of breakouts.
A gentle cleanser with no actives keeps oily skin feeling clean without adding irritation alongside adapalene.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports a skin barrier that scans on the drier side and helps the skin cope with adapalene.
Adapalene makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 is an essential partner.

response.routine_note: At night, cleanse, apply a pea-sized amount of adapalene to dry skin, then moisturizer, starting every second or third night and building up as skin tolerates it. Use the sunscreen every morning, and skip other exfoliating acids or scrubs while you settle in.
